node.title: Re^9: Easiest way to filter a file based on user input
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I added the line $limit = abs($limit); (see [doc://abs]) because I wasn't sure of your original specification, as I asked in [id://1194479|my post]. Also, note that -places=N is [mod://Regexp::Common::number|documented] as: "the number is assumed to have exactly N places after the radix point" and even goes on to show an example: "$RE{num}{real}{-places=>2} # matches 123.45 or -0.12", and your input isn't in that format. Take some time to look into the documentation and then try removing the line with abs, as well as "{-places=>2}" from the regex.
